name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: downloading an already-synced Plex-sourced item from the Catalog tab (the normal Download button, not the newer Browse tab) silently failed - it always built a Jellyfin-only DirectStream URL regardless of the source server's kind. Now branches on server kind the same way the Browse tab's download already does, resolving a Plex item's real rating key from the synced cache entry and downloading through the external catalog provider.
